edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. It writes your spacing rules. - E Black Shield is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Focused Resolve (W) roots at 675 range on a flat 12s cooldown — break it with range or line of sight before the second tick fires. Mantra empowers it into a longer root and self-heal, so respect her R charge too, not just the base W.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Q the tether break: step behind cover or out to 950 range and Focused Resolve's root snaps clean.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Her E shield is single-target — split pressure across two threats and one of your bindings always lands free.
